original_record.question:
A circle of radius 1 rolls along a straight line from the point $K$ to the point $L$, where $K L=11 \pi$. Which of the following pictures shows the correct appearance of the circle when it reaches $L$ ?
<image1>
<image2>
original_record.solution: The circumference is $2 \pi$, so every time the circle rolls $2 \pi$ it has turned $360^{\circ}$ and looks the same as it did at $K$. After $11 \pi$, it has turned $5 \frac{1}{2}$ turns, which is picture D.
